title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice P. M. Raval on 13.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 12/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 13.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 12/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-03/2026
It is hereby notified that on 13.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice P. M. Raval would not be available.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice M. R. Mengdey)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice P. M. Raval.)
By Order of Hon’ble The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
